preconditions.description: The length of the string S is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: S is a string of length N
preconditions.description: The input string S contains only lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output is either -1 (indicating no repeating non-overlapping substring exists) or a substring of S.
If the output is not -1, it is the longest repeating non-overlapping substring of S.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or output in S[:i] for some i
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, it appears at least once before any overlapping occurrence.
